preconditions.description: The length of the binary string s is between 1 and 2000, inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(c in '01' for c in s)
preconditions.description: The binary string s consists only of the characters '0' and '1'.

postconditions.description: The length of the binary string t is the same as the length of the binary string s.

postconditions.expression: t.count('0') == max(s.count('0') for s in all_substrings(s))
postconditions.description: The number of zeroes in t is the maximum possible number of zeroes in any substring of s.

postconditions.expression: all(longest_non_decreasing_subsequence_length(s[l-1:r]) == longest_non_decreasing_subsequence_length(t[l-1:r]) for l in range(1, len(s)+1) for r in range(l, len(s)+1))
postconditions.description: For any l and r, the length of the longest non-decreasing subsequence of the substring s[l-1:r] is equal to the length of the longest non-decreasing subsequence of the substring t[l-1:r].
